article.hook: Luck shows up in the details you can handle. Jupiter in Virgo asks: what skill will you sharpen, and who will you serve?
article.lived: For about a year, growth feels like crafting a tool from raw material - slow, exact, and useful. We stretch by fixing what’s off, whether a process at work or a habit in life. Meetings turn into checklists, and quiet moments become chances to improve one small thing. The kind of progress that happens here is a buildup of tiny wins, not leaps.
article.turn: The catch arrives when focusing tight turns to shrinking the whole picture. We get stuck debating if the font is right while the meeting’s goal slips away, or rinse the same problem under a microscope until it’s just noise. Use precision to serve your aim, not stall it. Over-fiddling wastes the luck you built.
moves: Pick one daily task and find a way to do it better by Friday.
